Thirty-three years ago, at the beginning of summer, in the 40th year of the Chinese Communist Party's usurpation of power,
an unprecedented movement of democracy and freedom, known as the Dreamforce Movement, was staged in China.
On the occasion of Hu Yaobang's death on April 15, 1989, due to the longstanding public grievance in China's social control by the Chinese Communist Party,
a large number of university students and teachers began to express their wish for freedom of the press and reform the political system in the name of mourning,
which gradually developed into a demonstration of Tiananmen Square.
However, the ruling Chinese Communist Party, which has always deceived and enslaved the Chinese people, was unlikely to respond positively to the people's demand,
and its violent reaction instead instilled a stronger need for justice among more Chinese people.
The movement in front of the Tiananmen Square quickly gained support by people all over the country,
and China showed massive support of the disintegration of communism in the world.
However, the Chinese Communist Party is by nature evil and dark,
and they quickly sensed the weakness of some of the so-called leader of the movement,
and took advantage of the movement to purge their political enemies within the party,
while in the same time using tanks and guns to carry out completely and bloody crackdown on people on Dreamforce.
The blood of at least thousands of innocent lives made the Dreamforce Movement finally become the Dreamforce tragedy.
However, the fire of the Dreamforce did not go out.
Mr. Guo Wengui was out of the Qingfeng detention center with a heavenly mission to launch and lead the whistleblower movement to take down the Chinese Communist Party.
The whistleblower movement also began to bond with more and more fellow fighters since the VOA cutoff incident in 2017.
Three years later, the declaration of the New Federalist of China was announced to the world on June 4, 2020.
It created a home for fellow fighters around the world, the New Federalist of China.
Now that the New Federalist of China is nearly two years old, the once unbeatable Chinese Communist Party and its Russian father has become global street rats,
while the G-series such as The Gather, Himalaya Federal Reserve, Himalaya Corns, G-Clubs, G-Fashion, G-Music, etc. are flourishing,
and the name of the New Federalist of China has been well known worldwide through the Ukrainian rescue.
Looking back at the Dreamforce incident, it was a significant tragedy in history.
Looking at it today, it is a temple of hope for the extermination of the Chinese Communist Party and the joy of our dear fellow fighters.
